objects.name: Analytic 2193
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies authentication attempts against Industrial Control System (ICS) network device management interfaces using well-known default vendor credentials from source Internet Protocol (IP) addresses not in the approved Network Management System (NMS) Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) subnet range. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: networkdevice:syslog
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Device authentication/audit log: successful authentication using a vendor-default or prohibited account from a non-approved management source

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Documented default username/password combinations for all device models in the environment.
